external_blockers: Official 16b x 128/1024/4096 SRAM macro vendor models (.lib/.lef/GDS) are absent; official macro timing/area/power cannot be signed off.
Official PDK + 150 MHz constraints + standard-cell library are absent; no STA/area/power signoff.
E203 SoC platform and official System Bus/NICE driver are absent; no SoC simulation.
Official hidden 600-sample evaluation set and official scoring script are absent.
No official signoff is claimed; submission remains pending primary acceptance.

frozen_case.note: A is the same deterministic input as full; W1/b1 are read-only layer00 tensors from the frozen A16W12 pack; no calibration.

limitations: Generic Yosys pre-techmap proxy only; SRAM wrappers are behavioural and expand to flops/memories in this flow, so the reported generic cell count is not macro area.
No 150 MHz SDC/STA, no PDK, no power/SAIF activity, no 2.25 mm2 closure.
The output-ready and bus-gap models are abstract rate/gap generators, not the official E203 System Bus/NICE protocol.
The TB is a memory/bus slave and output consumer; A/W/bias storage, the task scheduler, CACC and writeback are RTL. Golden values come from an independent Python integer model, never from DUT output.
Wait counters overlap in time and must not be summed.
No 12-layer parameter-switch run, no attention/encoder, no official 600 or hidden600 evaluation in this task.

precision_context.note: Frozen A16W12 pack is read-only input; this task does not recalibrate and does not evaluate NRMSE.

r4_context_not_acceptance.note: R4 numbers are context only. This worktree does not inherit them; the new architecture is measured independently and outputs 36-bit words (3 slots) instead of R4's 32-bit words (2 slots).
